name: Body-Bound Mind (Akashic)
body:
The energy of akasha courses through your mind, increasing your mental capacity.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, a power point reserve.

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can invest essence into this feat. You gain bonus power points equal to twice the invested essence. Once the amount of essence invested is chosen, it cannot be altered and remains invested for 24 hours. If you have the ability to bind a veil to your Head slot (even if you don’t have one currently bound), you gain an additional 2 bonus power points as long as at least 1 point of essence is invested in this feat.

You gain 1 point of essence.
